part.title: Seated ankles crossed - 3D Person, Seated
part.description:
Clothed adult figure in a seated ankles crossed pose (Priya: braided hair, coral athletic top, dark leggings). Category: Seated.

Static mesh with fitted, gravity-draped clothing baked into the geometry; no armature or animation. Bounding box 45 x 75 x 133 cm (W x D x H), modeled in meters at real-world scale with the feet at zero (standing height about 1.66 m). Skin, hair and clothing textures are embedded in the GLB. About 98k triangles. No ground plane. Useful as scale figures and entourage in lighting, architecture and interior scenes. Built by Innerscene from MakeHuman CC0 assets with original props; released CC0.
part.sourceName: Innerscene, adapted from MakeHuman CC0 assets

related.title: Idle standing - Harper 3D Person, Animated
related.description:
Harper, an adult in business clothes, performs an original idle standing loop for 6.000 seconds. In-place travel equivalent: 0 m/s.

The GLB carries the skinned character, its rig and one looping animation clip (6.00 s at 30 fps, cubic interpolation, seamless endpoints), played in place so a host can translate the figure at the stated speed; the pose at the playhead exports to other formats.

Original Innerscene character styling and authored motion from periodic pose recipes; no motion-capture data. Built from MakeHuman/MPFB CC0 body, rig and skin assets; released CC0.
